committee.sub: Morning brief · Tuesday 3 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Landing page test clicks now sit at 80, past the 75-click checkpoint, with zero generate_lead and zero review_cta_click events logged since start. The A$600 credit is fully drawn (creditRemainingExGst A$0), so both the red-flag check and the pause-or-continue decision are due once Chris confirms the qualified count.

No external edits show in the change history (externalLast24h 0, externalLast7d 0, status ok), so the test numbers stay clean of outside interference. CTR improved to 2.9% from 2.4% even as impressions fell to 581 from 698.

ask_cta_click sits at 18 since the test started versus 0 review_cta_click and 0 generate_lead, so the short question form is getting clicks but nothing is progressing to the deeper booking step or a lead.

Organic Search held flat at 8 sessions both weeks, still the only trustworthy unpaid signal, while AI Assistant sessions dropped to 0 from 1 and Direct (23, down from 28) still cannot be read as unpaid demand. Search Console data only runs through 31 Oct, so it lags yesterday (Mon 2) by about two days.

actions.text: Chris must check the test log now: raw paid clicks have reached 80, past the 75-click flag point, with zero qualified enquiries recorded in analytics. If the log confirms 75+ relevant clicks with still zero qualified, log the red flag.
Credit is exhausted (creditRemainingExGst A$0): apply the rule now, pause paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review.
Standing item: logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still needed.
Standing item: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update them to match current site stats.
